event.label: 2027 Kempsey Shire Council by-election
event.status: Council confirms a by-election for one councillor vacancy on Saturday 16 January 2027. Official timetable awaited.
event.dateBasis: Kempsey Shire Council confirms the polling date. The countdown marks the start of 16 January in Sydney. Nomination deadlines and polling hours are awaiting an official timetable.
event.contestantNote: The Council has announced the polling date. Official nominations have yet to be verified.

placeCoverageNotes: Published NSW OLG directory checked17October2026; not an independent verification of each councillor profile. Individual profile links and later changes require council source reconciliation.
ABS statistical geometry is exact to its source but is not a gazetted legal boundary. Previous contestants and legal ward geometry require reconciliation.

13 November 2026: Kempsey Shire Council’s published roster lists eight officeholders, including Deputy Mayor Arthur Bain. Noel Selby resigned effective 4 November. One councillor vacancy proceeds to the 16 January 2027 by-election.
stateResearchStatus: 13 November Hunter’s Hill Council South Ward by-election check: Nominations closed at noon AEDT on 11 November. NSWEC published 4 candidates in the 12 November ballot draw order. 13 November City of Coffs Harbour Council by-election check: Nominations closed at noon AEDT on 11 November. NSWEC published 5 candidates in the 12 November ballot draw order. 13 November Kempsey check: Noel Selby resigned effective 4 November. Council confirms a 16 January 2027 by-election and lists Arthur Bain as Deputy Mayor. 20 November scoped Walcha date check: NSWEC now publishes 16 January 2027 as the by-election date following Adam Iuston’s 23 October resignation. Nomination deadlines and polling hours remain unverified. Coffs Harbour nomination lodgement opened 2 November at 9 am AEDT, verified 3 November. Hunters Hill retains its published 2 November opening date without an independently verified opening hour. Both closed 11 November at noon AEDT. 20 November scoped Tenterfield A Ward date check: NSWEC now publishes a one-councillor by-election on 16 January 2027 following Gregory Purcell’s resignation effective 31 October. Nomination deadlines and polling hours remain unverified. Election review 1 November: Council's 20 October election notice dates Marc Lane's resignation to 14 October; 15 October is the earlier notice publication date, not the resignation date. Hunters Hill's confirmed 12 December by-election timetable is unchanged. The 31 October review of David Harris remains: he will not recontest Wyong at the 13 March 2027 state election, but remains MP and continues ministerial duties until then; no current vacancy. Cobar and Coffs Harbour retain their 30 October election review; Parliament composition retains its 23 October review and no full federal roster audit is claimed.
